# f5xc_k8s_cluster (Resource)

K8s cluster represents the real physical K8s cluster on the site. It can be used to configure various aspect of of the K8s cluster<br>e.g. Pod security, k8s_cluster roles, k8s_cluster role binding, User access to the K8s cluster etc.

To get more information about f5xc_k8s_cluster, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/k8s-cluster)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: K8s Cluster - Basic

resource "f5xc_k8s_cluster" "example" {
  name      = "example-k8s-cluster"
  namespace = "system"

  local_access_choice = {
    no_local_access = true
  }

  global_access_choice = {
    no_global_access = true
  }

  pod_security_policy_choice = {
    use_default_psp = true
  }

  cluster_role_choice = {
    use_default_cluster_roles = true
  }

  cluster_role_bindings_choice = {
    use_default_cluster_role_bindings = true
  }

  pod_security_admission_choice = {
    use_default_pod_security_admission = true
  }

  apps_choice = {
    no_cluster_wide_apps = true
  }

  insecure_registries_choice = {
    no_insecure_registries = true
  }

  cluster_scoped_resource_access_choice = {
    cluster_scoped_access_deny = true
  }

  vk8s_namespace_access_choice = {
    vk8s_namespace_access_deny = true
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: K8s Cluster - Full

resource "f5xc_k8s_cluster_role" "example_role" {
  name      = "example-k8s-cluster-role"
  namespace = "system"

  rule_choice = {
    policy_rule_list = {
      policy_rule = [{
        resource_choice = {
          resource_list = {
            api_groups     = ["apps"]
            resource_types = ["deployments"]
            verbs          = ["get", "list"]
          }
        }
      }]
    }
  }
}

resource "f5xc_k8s_cluster_role_binding" "example_crb" {
  name      = "example-k8s-cluster-role-binding"
  namespace = "system"

  k8s_cluster_role = {
    name      = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role.example_role.name
    namespace = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role.example_role.namespace
  }

  subjects = [
    {
      subject_choice = {
        user = "user1@example.com"
      }
    },
  ]
}

resource "f5xc_k8s_pod_security_admission" "example_psa" {
  name      = "example-k8s-pod-security-admission"
  namespace = "system"

  pod_security_admission_specs = [
    {
      policy_type_choice = {
        baseline = true
      }
      admission_mode_choice = {
        enforce = true
      }
    },
  ]
}

resource "f5xc_k8s_cluster" "example" {
  name        = "example-k8s-cluster"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "K8s cluster full example"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "example-team"
  }

  local_access_choice = {
    local_access_config = {
      local_domain = "example.com"
      port_choice = {
        port = 443
      }
    }
  }

  global_access_choice = {
    global_access_enable = true
  }

  pod_security_policy_choice = {
    use_default_psp = true
  }

  cluster_role_choice = {
    use_custom_cluster_role_list = {
      cluster_roles = [
        {
          name      = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role.example_role.name
          namespace = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role.example_role.namespace
        },
      ]
    }
  }

  cluster_role_bindings_choice = {
    use_custom_cluster_role_bindings = {
      cluster_role_bindings = [
        {
          name      = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role_binding.example_crb.name
          namespace = f5xc_k8s_cluster_role_binding.example_crb.namespace
        },
      ]
    }
  }

  pod_security_admission_choice = {
    use_custom_pod_security_admission = {
      name      = f5xc_k8s_pod_security_admission.example_psa.name
      namespace = f5xc_k8s_pod_security_admission.example_psa.namespace
    }
  }

  apps_choice = {
    cluster_wide_app_list = {
      cluster_wide_apps = [
        {
          app_choice = {
            dashboard = true
          }
        },
        {
          app_choice = {
            metrics_server = true
          }
        },
        {
          app_choice = {
            prometheus = true
          }
        },
      ]
    }
  }

  insecure_registries_choice = {
    insecure_registry_list = {
      insecure_registries = ["example.com:5000"]
    }
  }

  cluster_scoped_resource_access_choice = {
    cluster_scoped_access_permit = true
  }

  vk8s_namespace_access_choice = {
    vk8s_namespace_access_permit = true
  }
}
```

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--vk8s_namespace_access_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vk8s_namespace_access_choice`

Optional:

- `vk8s_namespace_access_deny` (Boolean) Deny VK8s namespace access Access to create, modify and delete resources in VK8s namespaces will be prevented for service accounts and Managed K8s clients. Resources in VK8s namespaces can be managed only through VK8s API or UI.<br>Conflicts with `vk8s_namespace_access_permit`.
- `vk8s_namespace_access_permit` (Boolean) Allow VK8s namespace access Access to create, modify and delete resources in VK8s namespaces will be allowed for service accounts and Managed K8s clients.<br>Conflicts with `vk8s_namespace_access_deny`.
## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_k8s_cluster.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_k8s_cluster.example
}
```
